plain: Famous and admired for great achievement.

webster.text: Conspicuous; distinguished by the reputation of greatness; renowned; eminent; as an illustrious general or magistrate; an illustrious prince.

more.text: Glorious; as an illustrious display of the divine perfections.

example.quote: A cloud of the most illustrious patriots of every age and country, where freedom has been enjoyed, might be adduced as witnesses in support of the sentiment.
example.cite: Brutus IX, New York Journal, Jan. 17, 1788
